Container.Name: unifi-netlens
Container.Overview: Self-hosted dashboard for a UniFi network. Per-device and per-app traffic with time charts and sessions; Wi-Fi signal, roaming and presence per device; access point, switch and gateway health; security events; local-network traffic; WAN status. It samples your UniFi console around the clock, so history is kept beyond UniFi's own short retention (24 hours of 5-minute data, 7 days hourly). Needs a UniFi OS console (UDM, UCG, UDR, Cloud Key Gen2+) and a local API key. Not affiliated with Ubiquiti.
Container.Requires: A UniFi OS console reachable from this server, and a local API key (UniFi Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations > Create API Key).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the dashboard in your browser.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Cache, settings and logs. Keep it on appdata so updates never lose history.

Config.Name: UniFi host
Config.Description: IP or hostname of your UniFi console.

Config.Name: UniFi API key
Config.Description: UniFi Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations > Create API Key. Shown only once in UniFi — copy it then.

Config.Name: UniFi site
Config.Description: Network site name. The site ID is looked up automatically.

Config.Name: Login password
Config.Description: Password for the dashboard (any user name). Strongly recommended: the dashboard can block devices.

Config.Name: Syslog port (ad-block stats)
Config.Description: Optional. Set to 5514 to receive UniFi's SIEM syslog (directly or relayed) for blocked-ad counts; blank = off.

Config.Name: Syslog TCP
Config.Description: Only used when the syslog port is 5514.

Config.Name: Syslog UDP
Config.Description: Only used when the syslog port is 5514.

Config.Name: UniFi site ID
Config.Description: Optional override; normally looked up automatically.
